bounded_trial.description: Declared explicit current and previous descriptor pointer locals, assigned them in retail table-access order, and commuted the equality operands while preserving signed-char comparison and calls.
bounded_trial.divergence: The table accesses moved toward the requested source order, but GC/1.3 reversed the entry type loads at 0x10 and 0x14 and still selected different descriptor registers at 0x24 through 0x30.
